At first light, tips for anyone travelling with a pet
Please give it some attention

Pet Travel Notice

Travelers must check all pet documents, carriers, and boarding details before arrival. Aurelia Skyways requires prompt, respectful communication so that Companion Animal Travel Desk staff can act without delay.

Please keep your animal calm and secure at every stage. Trained staff give each animal patient attention, and supervisors will listen carefully if a passenger is worried about the journey or handover.

If any issue arises, report it at once to the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Follow the desk guidance closely so your pet can travel safely and without avoidable disruption.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
